questions.prompt: How many lines of symmetry does a rectangle (not a square) have?
questions.explain: Its diagonals are not lines of symmetry.

questions.prompt: Which letter has a vertical line of symmetry?
questions.explain: Its left and right halves match.

questions.prompt: How many lines of symmetry does an equilateral triangle have?
questions.explain: One from each corner to the middle of the opposite side.

questions.prompt: Which shape cannot tile a floor without gaps?
Which shape has no line of symmetry?
questions.explain: No fold makes the halves match.

questions.prompt: How many lines of symmetry does a regular hexagon have?
questions.explain: Three through opposite corners and three through opposite sides.

questions.prompt: Explain how you can check whether a shape has a line of symmetry.
questions.modelAnswer: Fold the shape (or use a mirror) along a line. If the two halves match exactly, with every part lying on top of the other, that line is a line of symmetry.
